precondition_sources.text: A victim prepares a transaction calling swapAndBridgeWithETH() or swapAndBridgeWithERC20() and broadcasts it to the mempool.
The attacker sees the victim's transaction and frontruns it.
The attacker sends 1 wei to the selfdestruct contract before calling its selfdestruct function.
After EIP-6780 (Cancun), selfdestruct() forwards ETH to the beneficiary without destroying bytecode and the target cannot reject the ETH, so the same selfdestruct contract can be reused.

intent_sources.text: swapAndBridgeWithETH and swapAndBridgeWithERC20 must remain usable (not revert) regardless of whether the Slipstream SwapRouter holds any ETH.
